agent_responses.message: Hi, this is Emma from Atlas Web Studio. I know this is out of the blue. I saw Google Maps and review listings, but I could not find a full website, so I made a free homepage mockup idea for Northside Auto Repair. Are you the owner or manager?
Yeah, I'm the owner. Uh, what's the catch?

There isn't a catch, really. It is completely free to review, and if it is not useful, you can ignore it. I just wanted to show you a different homepage layout to compare against your current online presence.
So if I like it, what does an actual website cost?
Simple sites usually start around one thousand dollars. The final price depends on what you want built. The mockup is still free to review first, and there is no obligation.
Hmm, ok. And this mockup - it's actually free, no credit card, no "free trial" thing?
That's correct. It is completely free to review, and there is no obligation or sign-up required. I can send you a link to it, and you can take a look.
Would a real website actually make people trust the shop more, or is that just something you say?

I cannot promise that it will make people trust the shop more. However, a website can provide a clear and controlled space to present your services, directions, and other trust basics that first-time customers might look for before calling. It gives you a dedicated page to showcase your business in a way that you control.
Alright, that's a fair answer. Go ahead and send me the link.
I can send you a link. What email should I use?
It's mike at northsideauto dot com.
